title: Auto-close intent grammar misses sanctioned closeout commits

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Anchor required by the executor-result validator, which needs a single ancestor SHA. NOT a claim that nothing substantive followed it. This lane has three substantive commits: 44449322 (grammar + fail-closed tripwire), 8ace5346 (completion-gate SHA comparison, the P1 that survives the grammar fix), and 55c8fe10 (two escape hatches in the tripwire itself). An earlier revision of this note said everything after the anchor was proof-only, which was false and pointed a reviewer away from the two most consequential changes.

defect_1_grammar.producer_template: chore(lanes): close $ISSUE_ID — lane closed, sync file removed

defect_2_completion_gate_sha_comparison.summary: The truth-gated completion gate compared manifest .commit_sha against MERGE_SHA (github.sha). On the sanctioned closeout path github.sha is the closeout commit, created after the merge, so the comparison can never match. This survives the grammar fix: fixing extraction alone turns a silent no_close_intent ghost into a silent completion-withheld ghost.
defect_2_completion_gate_sha_comparison.reproduced_on: the real merged UTV2-1721 manifest on origin/main, not a fixture
defect_2_completion_gate_sha_comparison.refusal_message: manifest commit_sha X is not this merge SHA Y
defect_2_completion_gate_sha_comparison.fix: resolve_authoritative_merge_sha() reads the merge SHA the sanctioned closeout already recorded, from manifest .commit_sha and the truth-check receipt's .merge_sha — fields the gate already cross-checks — and resolves nothing when they disagree. No new contract. Non-closeout commits still resolve to the pushed SHA.
defect_2_completion_gate_sha_comparison.guarantee_restored_by: An ancestry check: the claimed merge SHA must be reachable from the pushed commit. Fails closed on any API error or missing token. Proved by making it fail with ancestry as the only changed variable.

defect.class: evidence-conflation: an aggregate green that conflates 'nothing to do' with 'the thing this workflow exists to do did not happen'. Both defects are instances, on the same path.

pnpm verify.attributable_to: ci:assert-staging refused the credential-containment sentinel host=127.0.0.1; writable DB verification requires the approved staging project. The containment guard working, not a lane failure.

static_proof.decision_path_tested: The completion decision was moved out of the workflow YAML into evaluate_completion_block() in the shared file so the harness drives the real decision path — extraction, signature, SHA resolution, completion gate — over realistic manifests and closeout ancestry. Testing ID extraction alone is how the SHA-comparison defect survived.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Three-way agreement proven by a clean ops:orchestration-reconcile run

known_limitations: Exit criteria 2, 3 and 4 (sanctioned replay, three-way agreement, zero ghosts) are NOT satisfied by this bundle. It covers exit criterion 1, the fail-closed requirement, and the completion-gate SHA-comparison P1. The replay is a post-merge acceptance phase: this issue must not be marked Done until the sanctioned replay produces three-way GitHub/manifest/Linear agreement and ORCH-MERGED-PR-LINEAR-DONE returns 0.

Five escape hatches in the controls themselves were found by successive adversarial review of this lane and closed, each reproduced before being fixed: a prose-grep opt-out test any commit mentioning plan-only/partial-fix could silence; a whole-message signature scan that fired on commits merely describing a closeout template; a revert of a closeout that reddened main; a scope asymmetry where extraction matched any column-0 line while the signature read only the subject; and a third unaligned scope in the raw-form scan the tripwire consults, which let a drifted subject be silenced by a closeout line in its body. Four of the five are the same bug class - two code paths disagreeing about which part of the commit message they read - which is why a case now asserts all three scopes agree rather than two.

The reconciler emits no sanctioned repair action for ORCH-MERGED-PR-LINEAR-DONE. Its repair_plan contains 3 actions, all for open-PR-without-manifest and closed-branch-cleanup states. The replay path for these 25 rows is therefore a workflow_dispatch re-run of post-merge-lane-close.yml per affected PR, not an ops:manifest-repair invocation.
This lane may not produce its own t1-approved label or pm-verdict/v1 comment.
